trainer/30461.htm.text: Magister Mirien: What was your first impression of Dion? Perhaps you felt, as I did, that it is a land filled with evil power. I suspect it is the influence of the Giants' relics in the northern town. Their legacy is still felt here...

trainer/30461-noteach.htm.text: Magister Mirien: This is not a place for the likes of you. Go find your own Master. Where do your stars lead? Always observe your surroundings with care.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30461-02.html.text: Magister Mirien: 'Scholar' is a term used to describe all high level Magicians of the Ivory Tower. They are the ones we count on to research magic and make sense of the chaotic world we live in. They are also charged with educating our young... The Scholar is qualified to teach the highest-level ma…

Only those who possess a passion for research and humility in learning will advance to the level of high magic and knowledge. I can tell that research is not your strong suit. Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30461-05.html.text: Magister Mirien: Did you meet the High Priest Sylvain ? He is here in this temple. The High Priest Sylvain will give you a task concerning the 'Scholar's Trial'. When you have completed it, come back to me.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30461-06.html.text: Magister Mirien: Good job. I understand that High Priest Sylvain asked you to bring back the Crystal of Purity? Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30461-07.html.text: Magister Mirien: Have you met Grand Magister Jurek ? He is in the Wizard's Guild of the Town of Giran . You must complete the task he gives you in order to advance.

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30461-08.html.text: Magister Mirien: You have brought the mark of Grand Magister Jurek! Good job. Your integrity gladdens my heart. There is only one challenge remaining, expand your abilities and do your best.
when: state STARTED; has items 2676,2698; lacks items 2675

Q00214_TrialOfTheScholar/30461-11.html.text: Magister Mirien: Are you hard of hearing? Your time has not come. Come back when you have completed more training.

Now we can move forward with our study about the mutated Kaneus and the nature of Kamaloka. Soon we will discover their underlying nature! This is only the beginning of a long journey to find the truth.

common/skill_enchant_help_01.htm.text: Skill Enchanting allows you to strengthen certain skills that have reached their maximum level. You must be level 76 or above and have completed your 3rd class transfer in order to take advantage of this system. To enchant your skills, simply speak to Agathion Pona. To do this, open your skills win…

common/skill_enchant_help_02.htm.text: Back in the day, Skill Enchanting was a tedious process that could only be done through specific people throughout the land. But those days are gone. Now all you have to do is open your skill window and click on the Skill Enchanting button at the bottom. How easy is that!

common/skill_enchant_help_03.htm.text: There are several Skill Enchanting options at your disposal: General Skill Enchant, Blessed Skill Enchant, Skill Un-Enchanting and Skill Route Change.
